name: Fran Dragovic
source: A Serbian student and classmate of Erik, Fran is certainly quite the character. Good friends with the Volkova twins and bitter rivals with Lena. Flirtatious to a fault, they delight in retelling their various sexual escapades and confusing people over their gender.
